understanding.mechanics_understanding: On each turn you choose a horizontal action (MOVE_LEFT or MOVE_RIGHT), after which gravity automatically carries the character in the current gravity direction until they land on a solid support tile, hit a hazard (spikes 'u'/'v' causing immediate failure), or reach the goal '+'. CLICK can be used on specific clickable tiles (notably breakable blocks 'x') by specifying a target [x, y] to remove/alter them to open or change fall paths; clicks do not consume moving-platform time when that mechanic is present. UNDO reverts the previous action. Each level provides 2 attempts with up to 50 turns per attempt, and failure restarts the level.
